SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.total_copies, b.total_copies - COALESCE(loan_stats.active_count, 0) AS available_copies, CASE WHEN COALESCE(loan_stats.overdue_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'overdue' WHEN b.total_copies - COALESCE(loan_stats.active_count, 0) <= 0 THEN 'on-loan' ELSE 'available' END AS status FROM book b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN due_at < #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count FROM loan WHERE returned_at IS NULL GROUP BY book_id ) loan_stats ON loan_stats.book_id = b.id
AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY b.title
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, isbn, published_year, total_copies) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{publishedYear}, #{totalCopies})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, published_year = #{publishedYear}, total_copies = #{totalCopies} WHERE id = #{id}
